_readme: Relay (TURN) servers for multiplayer. Without one, only players whose networks can reach each other directly will connect; everyone else times out.
Metered free tier (20 GB/month): sign up at https://dashboard.metered.ca, create an app, copy the API key, then set credentialsUrl below to:
That endpoint returns a ready-made iceServers array and rotates the credentials on every load.
Alternatively paste servers directly into iceServers and leave credentialsUrl empty.
Check the result in the game under Multiplayer -> Test connection.
